answer: Sparrow spiral tournament bond: each identity locks 70 credits, enters one sparrow in a spiral tournament in a gale, pays 30. Each epoch the bracket pairs sparrows; auditors check turns on the table. A sparrow missing the table, or shared by a rented-flock ring, burns its bond. The k-th fake pays 100, and paired sparrows cancel, so 1,000 fakes pay 100,000 for one survivor chasing 40,000. An honest agent pays 30 once, keeps its bond.
